id: 47_What should be included in a Biorisk management plan laboratory trending raqbami
title: 一份管用的生物风险管理计划
source_doc: course/Microbiology Biosafety/47_What should be included in a Biorisk management plan laboratory trending raqbami.md
author_source: project/Microbiology Biosafety/47_What should be included in a Biorisk management plan laboratory trending raqbami/src.py

points.K1: 评估、减缓、绩效，循环改进
points.S1: 先摸清危险源，列出清单
points.S2: 应急物资：定点放，定期查
points.S3: 计划经学院审核，学校存档

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验室门口，手里举着一本空白封面的厚文件夹，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a laboratory door, holding up a thick binder with a blank cover and waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 实验室安全，要有一份总计划。
overlay: 一份管用的生物风险管理计划

shots.scene: 文件夹打开，内页是九个空白格子
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the binder opens to a page with nine neat blank boxes. No people.
shots.narration: 今天看看，计划里该写些什么。

shots.scene: 老周的课题组刚拿到新的微生物实验项目，老周把空白文件夹交给小研
shots.prompt_en: The older man hands a blank binder to the female graduate student in a microbiology lab office.
shots.narration: 老周的课题组，新接了微生物项目。

shots.scene: 小研翻开文件夹，里面全是空白页，她皱起眉头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens the binder and finds only blank pages; she frowns.
shots.narration: 小研要起草安全计划，无从下手。

shots.scene: 阿杰凑过来，拿着一张只写了一行的空白纸
shots.prompt_en: The young male student leans in, holding a sheet of paper with one short blank line.
shots.narration: 阿杰说：写一句注意安全，不就行了？

shots.scene: 欣欣摇头，在白板上画出一个圆环
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot shakes its head and draws a large ring on a whiteboard.
shots.narration: 欣欣说：计划要能指导每天的工作。

shots.section_title: 评估、减缓、绩效，循环改进
shots.scene: 圆环外圈分成三段，分别是放大镜、盾牌、仪表盘图标
shots.prompt_en: A ring whose outer band is split into three parts with a magnifying glass icon, a shield icon and a gauge icon. No people.
shots.narration: 生物风险管理，有三个支柱。
overlay: 评估、减缓、绩效，循环改进

shots.section_title: 评估、减缓、绩效，循环改进
shots.scene: 放大镜扫过培养皿和离心管
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass icon passes over a petri dish and a centrifuge tube. No people.
shots.narration: 评估：找出风险有多大。

shots.section_title: 评估、减缓、绩效，循环改进
shots.scene: 盾牌挡在生物安全柜和防护用品前
shots.prompt_en: A shield icon stands in front of a biosafety cabinet, gloves and a lab coat. No people.
shots.narration: 减缓：用措施把风险降下来。

shots.section_title: 评估、减缓、绩效，循环改进
shots.scene: 仪表盘指针从红区转到绿区
shots.prompt_en: A gauge needle moves from the red zone to the green zone. No people.
shots.narration: 绩效：检验措施到底管不管用。

shots.section_title: 评估、减缓、绩效，循环改进
shots.scene: 圆环内圈四格依次亮起，箭头首尾相连转动
shots.prompt_en: The inner circle of the ring has four quadrants lighting up in turn, with arrows rotating around them. No people.
shots.narration: 里面是计划、实施、检查、改进。

shots.section_title: 评估、减缓、绩效，循环改进
shots.scene: 圆环转了一圈又一圈，像螺旋一样上升
shots.prompt_en: The ring turns again and again, rising like a spiral staircase. No people.
shots.narration: 转一圈，提高一点，循环往复。

shots.scene: 九个空白格子组成的清单，旁边一支笔
shots.prompt_en: A checklist of nine blank boxes with a pen beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 一份完整的计划，包括九块内容。

shots.scene: 小研把文件夹分成九个彩色分隔页
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student divides the binder with nine colored tab dividers.
shots.narration: 小研把文件夹分成九个部分。

shots.scene: 实验室平面图上用框线圈出几个房间
shots.prompt_en: A floor plan of a lab with several rooms outlined by a bold frame. No people.
shots.narration: 第一块：范围，管哪些房间。

shots.scene: 培养皿、样本管、生物安全柜图标排成一列
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a petri dish, sample tubes and a biosafety cabinet line up in a row. No people.
shots.narration: 用哪些微生物，做哪些实验。

shots.scene: 箭靶图标，箭头正中靶心
shots.prompt_en: A target icon with an arrow hitting the bullseye. No people.
shots.narration: 再写目标：要达到怎样的安全状态。

shots.scene: 目标清单上几行空白，每行前有一个勾选框
shots.prompt_en: A blank goal list with checkboxes in front of each line. No people.
shots.narration: 目标要具体，能检查。

shots.scene: 组织结构图：上面一个大方框，下面分出几个小方框，方框空白
shots.prompt_en: An organization chart with one large blank box at the top branching into several smaller blank boxes. No people.
shots.narration: 第二块：角色与职责。

shots.scene: 老周站在结构图顶端位置旁
shots.prompt_en: The older man stands next to the top box of the organization chart.
shots.narration: 实验室负责人，是第一责任人。

shots.scene: 小研胸前别上空白徽章，站在中间方框旁
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wears a blank badge and stands next to a middle box of the chart.
shots.narration: 安全员负责日常检查和提醒。

shots.scene: 阿杰站在最下层方框旁，手里拿着空白规程
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands next to a bottom box, holding a blank procedure sheet.
shots.narration: 每个实验人员，按规程做好自己。

shots.scene: 王老师和老李分别站在结构图两侧
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator and the facility engineer stand on either side of the chart.
shots.narration: 学校管理和设施保障，也要写明。

shots.scene: 放大镜下出现病原、锐器、气溶胶三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Under a magnifying glass appear three icons: a microbe, a needle and an aerosol cloud. No people.
shots.narration: 第三块：风险评估怎么做。

shots.scene: 流程图：识别、分析、定措施，三个方框箭头相连
shots.prompt_en: A flowchart of three blank boxes connected by arrows: magnifying glass, scale, shield icons. No people.
shots.narration: 先识别危害，再判断风险高低。

shots.scene: 小研和老周一起填写空白评估表
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the older man fill in a blank risk assessment form together.
shots.narration: 写清谁来评估，用什么方法。

shots.scene: 日历图标和新仪器、新样品图标，箭头指向评估表
shots.prompt_en: A calendar icon, a new instrument icon and a new sample icon all point to the assessment form. No people.
shots.narration: 定期评估，有变化时重新评估。

shots.scene: 一叠空白规程，每张左上角有不同的仪器图标
shots.prompt_en: A stack of blank procedure sheets, each with a different instrument icon in the corner. No people.
shots.narration: 第四块：标准操作规程。

shots.scene: 离心机、生物安全柜、高压灭菌器图标各连一张规程
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a centrifuge, a biosafety cabinet and an autoclave, each linked to its own blank procedure sheet. No people.
shots.narration: 关键操作和设备，各有一份。

shots.scene: 阿杰在安全柜前，对照贴在旁边的空白规程操作
shots.prompt_en: The young male student works at a biosafety cabinet, checking a blank procedure sheet posted beside it.
shots.narration: 按规程一步步做，不凭记忆。

shots.scene: 王老师在培训室讲课，台下小研和阿杰听讲
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator teaches a training session; the female graduate student and the young male student listen.
shots.narration: 第五块：培训与能力跟踪。

shots.scene: 小研在安全柜前实操，王老师拿着空白评分表
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student demonstrates at a biosafety cabinet while the safety administrator holds a blank score sheet.
shots.narration: 培训后要考核，会做才算数。

shots.scene: 一张空白人员能力表，几行打勾，几行空着
shots.prompt_en: A blank staff competency table with some rows checked and some rows empty. No people.
shots.narration: 谁会做什么，表上一目了然。

shots.scene: 日历上圈出一个日期，旁边是复训图标
shots.prompt_en: A calendar with one date circled, next to a refresher training icon. No people.
shots.narration: 定期复训，能力要跟得上。

shots.scene: 台面上打翻的培养瓶图标，旁边红色感叹号
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a tipped-over culture flask on a bench with a red exclamation mark. No people.
shots.narration: 第六块：出了事怎么办。

shots.scene: 流程卡：停止、处置、报告，三个图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank flow card with three icons: a stop hand, a spill kit, a phone. No people.
shots.narration: 溢洒、暴露，先按预案处置。

shots.scene: 逐级报告的箭头：实验室、学院、学校
shots.prompt_en: Arrows show reporting steps from a lab icon to a department icon to a university icon. No people.
shots.narration: 再逐级报告，不隐瞒不拖延。

shots.scene: 墙上贴着空白应急联系卡，电话图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank emergency contact card with a phone icon posted on the lab wall. No people.
shots.narration: 联系电话，写进计划贴上墙。

shots.scene: 老李在检查生物安全柜，手拿空白检查表
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer inspects a biosafety cabinet, holding a blank checklist.
shots.narration: 第七块：维护与检查计划。

shots.scene: 日历上安全柜、灭菌器、洗眼器图标分布在不同日期
shots.prompt_en: A calendar with biosafety cabinet, autoclave and eyewash icons placed on different dates. No people.
shots.narration: 哪台设备，多久查一次，写成日程。

shots.scene: 设备上贴着空白合格标签，旁边绿色勾
shots.prompt_en: A device with a blank inspection tag and a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 检定合格贴标签，过期停用。

shots.scene: 文件柜里整齐排列的文件夹，每个侧面空白
shots.prompt_en: A file cabinet with neatly arranged binders, each spine blank. No people.
shots.narration: 第八块：文件与记录。

shots.scene: 新旧两份规程，旧版盖上作废印章
shots.prompt_en: Two procedure sheets; the old one gets a red void stamp while the new one stays. No people.
shots.narration: 文件要有版本，旧版及时收回。

shots.scene: 培训、检查、事件记录三个空白本子并排
shots.prompt_en: Three blank logbooks side by side with training, inspection and incident icons. No people.
shots.narration: 培训、检查、事件，都要留记录。

shots.scene: 小研在记录本上签名并写日期
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student signs and dates an entry in a blank logbook.
shots.narration: 记录要及时、真实、能追溯。

shots.scene: 王老师带着空白检查表走进实验室，老周陪同
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator walks into the lab with a blank checklist, accompanied by the older man.
shots.narration: 第九块：评审与审核。

shots.scene: 检查表上几项打勾，一项打叉，箭头指向整改
shots.prompt_en: A checklist with several check marks and one red cross; an arrow points to a fix-it icon. No people.
shots.narration: 定期看计划落实得怎么样。

shots.scene: 圆环中的改进格亮起，箭头回到计划格
shots.prompt_en: The act quadrant of the ring lights up and an arrow loops back to the plan quadrant. No people.
shots.narration: 发现问题就改，计划随之更新。

shots.section_title: 先摸清危险源，列出清单
shots.scene: 小研拿着空白清单，在实验室里逐个看冰箱、试剂柜、仪器
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks around the lab with a blank list, checking the freezer, the chemical cabinet and instruments.
shots.narration: 写计划前，先摸清家底。
overlay: 先摸清危险源，列出清单

shots.section_title: 先摸清危险源，列出清单
shots.scene: 清单上依次出现微生物、化学瓶、锐器、高压设备图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a microbe, a chemical bottle, a needle and a pressure vessel appear one by one on the list. No people.
shots.narration: 菌种、化学品、锐器、设备，都列上。

shots.section_title: 先摸清危险源，列出清单
shots.scene: 清单旁一个日历图标，箭头表示更新
shots.prompt_en: A calendar icon beside the list with a refresh arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 清单随时更新，计划才对得上。

shots.section_title: 应急物资：定点放，定期查
shots.scene: 墙角挂着溢洒处置包、急救箱，旁边是洗眼器
shots.prompt_en: A spill kit and a first aid box hang in a corner next to an eyewash station. No people.
shots.narration: 应急物资，要写进计划。
overlay: 应急物资：定点放，定期查

shots.section_title: 应急物资：定点放，定期查
shots.scene: 小研打开溢洒处置包，对照空白清单清点
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens the spill kit and checks its contents against a blank list.
shots.narration: 定点放好，人人知道在哪。

shots.section_title: 应急物资：定点放，定期查
shots.scene: 过期的消毒剂瓶被打叉，换上新瓶
shots.prompt_en: An expired disinfectant bottle is crossed out in red and replaced with a new one. No people.
shots.narration: 定期清点，过期的及时补换。

shots.section_title: 计划经学院审核，学校存档
shots.scene: 老周把装订好的计划交给王老师
shots.prompt_en: The older man hands the finished binder to the safety administrator.
shots.narration: 计划写好后，交学院审核。
overlay: 计划经学院审核，学校存档

shots.section_title: 计划经学院审核，学校存档
shots.scene: 文件上盖上印章，放进学校档案柜
shots.prompt_en: A stamp is pressed onto the binder, which is then placed into a university archive cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 学校存档，和三级管理衔接。

shots.section_title: 计划经学院审核，学校存档
shots.scene: 全组成员围坐学习计划，各自签名
shots.prompt_en: The older man, the female graduate student and the young male student sit together reading the plan and signing a blank sheet.
shots.narration: 组内人人学习，知道自己的职责。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前，九个格子依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a whiteboard where nine boxes light up one by one.
shots.narration: 范围目标、职责、评估和规程。

shots.scene: 后五个格子亮起：培训、应急、维护、记录、审核图标
shots.prompt_en: Five more boxes light up with training, emergency, maintenance, records and audit icons.
shots.narration: 培训、应急、维护、记录和审核。

shots.scene: 圆环转动，螺旋上升
shots.prompt_en: The ring turns and rises in a spiral. No people.
shots.narration: 评估、减缓、绩效，循环改进。

shots.scene: 小研把写满的文件夹放到书架上，阿杰竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts a full binder on the shelf; the young male student gives a thumbs-up.
shots.narration: 计划写实了，安全才落得了地。

shots.scene: 欣欣抱着文件夹向镜头挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot hugs the binder and waves goodbye to the camera.
shots.narration: 计划写好更要做好，再见！
